content:
Today I found a really old video of some [fingerboard](http://fingerboard.com/ "official website") tricks that I've recorded, when I was addicted to it :P

I still carry my fingerboard in my pocket, and when that movie was shot I even got some support from a foreign fingerboard trademark. It's a really wicked "sport", you can break a leg, but you still can practice the "portable" version ;D

Here's the video:

`youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QtruOZhVxVQ`
